title: A hatch opens onto another world
alt: From inside a dark cabin hatch we see a suited astronaut backing onto Eagle's porch, with a ladder disappearing below and the bright lunar surface beyond.
context: Armstrong emerged from Eagle before descending the ladder. The body pose, interior surfaces and camera position are artistic interpretations.
interpretation: Original story illustration. Viewpoint, lighting, pose, geometry and apparent distances are interpretive. Scientific arrows, waves, cutaways and displays explain principles; they are not recorded telemetry, a literal instrument diagram or a historical photograph.
